specs.delivery_status: All 23 previously missing animation keys delivered; see verify_report.json for acceptance and weak spots.
specs.mounted_frame: 640x512, anchor (320,490), 360px standing height; includes mounted death and dismount.
specs.pipeline: Grok subscription sprite-gen video-set, video-frames and video-loop (with RIFE installed). Existing first-pass image/native-video assets retained. Editorial frame selection, explicit dismount endpoint composite, and per-frame feet registration documented in alignment.json and video2/editorial_picks.json.
specs.build_order: finalize.py -> p27_assets.py -> stage-1 documentation/preview/verification -> stage2_build.py -> stage2_enemies.py -> stage2_verify.py -> stage2_delivery.py
specs.integration: This sub-manifest is separate, frames are relative to art/stage2/. Prefix each frame/sheet by stage2/ when merging into art/manifest.json. No game code or stage-1 manifest changed.
specs.jump_contract: Jump pose feet are fixed to (160,300); apply jumper_jump.render_y_offsets to visual only, not ground collision origin.
specs.dismount_contract: Generated transition ends in exact camel_foot_idle_00; keep camel corpse as separate game object.
specs.boss_body_frame: 1024x640, anchor (512,610), every body state including death.
specs.boss_delivery: Sandwhale requested art present; see boss/verify_report.json for final acceptance.
specs.boss_build_order: finalize.py -> p27_assets.py -> stage1 docs -> stage2_enemies.py -> stage2_boss_build.py -> stage2_verify.py -> stage2_delivery.py -> stage2_boss_delivery.py
